integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from Hanner's inequalities and explicit equality cases. The bundled finite-dimensional script is only a consistency check and is not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the unrestricted generalized James constant on real sequence spaces \(\ell_p(I)\) with at least two coordinates. It does not assert the same formula for arbitrary Banach lattices, subspaces of \(\ell_p\), older three-vector generalized James coefficients, or Birkhoff-orthogonality-restricted variants.
title: Exact generalized James constant of real \(\ell_p\)
